description: This file defines a Java class 'LogView' that extends TextView and implements LogNode interface. It is used for displaying log messages within an Android application, formatting log data, and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface, with formatting and chaining capabilities.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data and displays it in the LogView. Also passes the log data to the next LogNode in the chain if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line within the LogView.
